name: maple_1
prompt: Generate ONE image, 1536x1024, landscape: a flat, straight-on, evenly lit, high-resolution photograph of a single sheet of real figured birdseye / burl maple veneer under clear gloss lacquer, filling the whole frame edge to edge. Warm honey-gold amber tone, dense small birdseye dimples and tight burl clusters with soft chatoyant figure, fine darker pin knots, grain running horizontally, exactly like a 1970s pedal steel guitar cabinet. No shadows, no reflections, no edges, no objects, no vignetting, no text: just the wood surface, sharp and detailed, so it can be used as a texture.
